mentions.name: AI Trading Competition
mentions.description: This project runs an ongoing paper-trading experiment with 29 accounts on real US stock prices, each funded with $100k in paper money since July 27. Four AI models (ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Gemini) each write a trading rulebook and rewrite it every day based on their own results, while one control account runs a fixed rulebook no AI touches. All results are published publicly, including losses and retired strategies, with the full trade file available as CSV.
mentions.problem: Tests whether AI-written trading rulebooks can outperform a fixed non-AI rulebook and the S&P 500.
